---

This site presents the migrated notes as static marimo HTML pages. The notebooks remain runnable locally with the `lock5stat-env` conda environment.

::: {.callout-note}
Read the result in the browser, then open the source notebook when you want to run or edit it.
:::

## Start with a question

- [Browse the complete notebook library](notes.html)
- [Open the validated ANOVA note](notes/UnitB-Anova/ch05/p540-rat-fat.html)
- [Open a linear regression note](notes/UnitA-LinearRegression/ch02/bookpages-price-reg.html)
- [Open a time-series note](notes/UnitD-Timeseries/ch12/p1446-cpi-arima-model.html)

## Built to stay close to the data

The Python notes use Polars for tabular data, Great Tables for exploratory summaries, and SciPy or statsmodels for statistical models where the Julia analysis has been translated.

See the [migration guide](MIGRATION.html) for coverage and environment details.
